text:
lucy: Quick heads-up 1 Cloud Nexus Summit hands-on lab. We're running a co-hosted demo lane with StratusLabs. They want a co-branded 'Demo Passbook' (folded booklet) for attendees to collect stamps. Need: final art owner, manifest for hand-carried demo kit, and plan for staggered swag shipments to EU/NA booths.

raj: I'll take art handoff from design and do a print check. Uploading demo_pass_v3.png now. Printer needs 3mm bleed.

emily: Shipping note: I'd rather hand-carry the GPU enclosure (1 unit) + peripherals; ship the rest as freight. Airline people asked for ATA carnet? We can do temporary import letter if carnet is too heavy. @legal-bot any preference?

legal-bot: Temporary import letter is fine for value <$20k/unit. Carnet recommended for >2 countries but adds fees. Provide serials and insured values by Tue.

tom: Demo kit inventory: 1x rack GPU enclosure (serial G1-771), 2x demo laptops, 1x network switch, 3x NVMe drive trays. I'll attach packing_list.csv. Label handcarry items with "RDW-HAND-1".

becca: Swagbot update: Demo Passbooks printed: 1,200 NA, 600 EU. Stickers and polos split: 1,000 stickers NA (tracking ABC999), 400 EU (tracking EU123). ETA to SF warehouse 6 days.

Swagbot: Reminder: order reference #RDW-CLD-2247. Fulfillment scheduled Wed pick.

lucy: Good. @raj can you confirm printer proofs by EOD Mon? Also need volunteer shifts for passbook stamping table: 3 shifts/day (morning, midday, close).

raj: Proofs due this afternoon. I'll post screenshot in thread.

emily: I can staff Fri midday and Sat morning.

tom: I'll cover Thu close and do tech handoff with Stratus at 09:30 local on setup day. Need their tech contact.

lucy: Stratus lead is Marco (marco@stratus.example). @tom pls set a 20-min dry run with them at 09:30.

becca: Courier-bot says consolidated freight pickup booked for Mon 0800. Tracking: FRT4567. EU pallet arrives Wed 1400 local.

courier-bot: Pickup confirmed. Documents: commercial invoice, packing list, and temporary import letter required at handoff.

lucy: Final asks: (1) @raj upload print-ready PDF with bleed, (2) @tom finalize serials and insured values to legal-bot, (3) @becca confirm volunteer roster by Thu. I'll create a 1-pager runbook (setup timeline, booth contact numbers, stamping script) and share before EOD Wed. Thanks! :tada:
